2609.11170.title: Breaking Predictions Is Not Enough: Specified-Foil Counterfactuals for Temporal Graphs
2609.11170.paper_summary: Temporal graph counterfactual explanations typically change past events to change or invalidate an original prediction, while leaving its replacement unspecified. Yet a user facing a predicted outcome often asks which past conditions would make a particular alternative occur instead. We formulate this destination-specific question as the Specified-Foil Counterfactual: given an original prediction A and a foil B fixed before search, find a low-cost past-event intervention under which the same predictor selects B as top-ranked. Our trace-guided intervention search contrasts the completed execution of A with a reconstructed incomplete execution of B, maps their difference to DELETE, INSERT, REWIRE, RELABEL, and SHIFT operations, and verifies B through exact replay. We instantiate this principle with LiFTER on continuous-time dynamic graphs and TLogic on temporal knowledge graphs. On CTDGs, the method retains 85.7-93.6% of black-box greedy successes while reducing predictor evaluations by 75.0-80.0%; on TKGs, it reaches the specified foil in 74.8% of 600 comparisons. Executable traces thereby become computational structures for constructing conditions of unselected alternatives, rather than records used only to explain predictions already made.
2609.11170.paper_summary_zh: 時間圖的反事實解釋通常會改變過去的事件，以改變或無效化原始預測，同時不指定其替代方案。<lb/>然而，面對預測結果的用戶經常會問哪些過去的條件會使特定的替代方案發生。<lb/>我們將這個針對特定目的的問題表述為指定反事實：給定一個原始預測 A 和在搜尋之前固定的反例 B，尋找一個低成本的過去事件干預，使得相同的預測器將 B 選為最高排名。<lb/>我們的追蹤引導干預搜尋將 A 的完整執行與 B 的重建不完整執行進行對比，將它們的差異映射到刪除、插入、重接、重新標籤和移動操作，並通過精確重播來驗證 B。<lb/>我們在連續時間動態圖上用 LiFTER 實現這一原則，並在時間知識圖上用 TLogic 實現。<lb/>在 CTDGs 上，該方法保留了 85.7-93.6% 的黑箱貪婪成功率，同時將預測器評估減少了 75.0-80.0%；在 TKGs 上，它在 600 次比較中達到了 74.8% 的指定反例。<lb/>可執行的追蹤因此成為構建未選擇替代方案條件的計算結構，而不僅僅是用於解釋已做出預測的記錄。
2609.11170.author: Minwoo Yu et.al.
